A website and branding studio in Tashkent

Since 2025 we've been making websites, logos and content for businesses in Uzbekistan. We work with clinics, restaurants, tourism, pharma and service companies.

Discuss your projectWe reply within an hour

How we keep our word

  1. We don't overpromise

    Not on price, timing or what's possible. If something can't be done on time, we say so before signing.

  2. Everything goes into the contract

    Scope, price and deadline are agreed before we start. You know what you'll get and when.

  3. We own the deadline

    If we're late, it's 10% off for every day, up to 30%, plus free revisions.

  4. We flag problems first

    If we spot a problem outside the brief, we tell you, even when you didn't ask.

Who works on your project

You deal with one person, your project manager. Everyone else joins when their part of the work is needed.

  • Project manager

    Replies within an hour, runs the project from first message to launch and keeps it on schedule.

    Your contact

  • Design

    Visuals, logos and brand identity. Responsible for the quality of every screen.

  • Development

    Front-end, load speed, mobile version and launch on your domain.

  • Content

    Copy, carousels and stories that bring people to your site.

How we work

Four steps from first message to launch.

  1. 1

    You message us

    A project manager replies within an hour and clarifies the brief.

  2. 2

    We sign a contract

    It sets out the scope, price and deadline. Pay 50/50 or 40/30/30 by stage.

  3. 3

    We build

    We collect texts, photos and access. The contract clock starts that day.

  4. 4

    We launch

    The site runs on your domain, and you keep all files and access.

Content from templates, not from scratch

We build carousels and stories from templates based on your brand book. Your SMM specialist gets finished on-brand visuals, not drafts.
